**Finding: compliant (at the fallback).**

- **Customer exit:** § 17(b) (p0118) lets Sparkling terminate the Agreement at any time on 90 calendar days' written notice — within the fallback 60–90 day window.
- **No penalty:** § 11 (p0084) and the Fee Schedule impose no early-termination fee or acceleration, so the three-months' fees cap is satisfied at nil.
- **Vendor side:** Garman's only termination rights are the insolvency/uncured-default triggers in § 17(c) (p0119–p0128); no convenience right exists anywhere (checked §§ 7, 8, 10 reject and maintenance provisions), which meets the fallback and the preferred "no Vendor convenience right" element.
- **Noted, not redlined:** notice is 90 rather than 30 days, and there is no express pro-rata refund of prepaid fees on a Sparkling convenience exit (refunds arise only on Garman default). These are preferred-level gaps only, so no redline was proposed.
